_meta.note: All in-game story text. {name} is replaced with the player's nickname (or 'Volunteer'). Speakers: karim, zain, hira, bilal, sara, hudhud. Characters never recommend a stall or praise one kind of choice over another.

story.caption: Gulshan Model School has a big day coming. The annual Apna Mela opens in just five days!
But the banner is torn, the stalls are empty and Ustad Karim needs volunteers. Fast.
Then a hoopoe with tiny golden spectacles flutters down from the old neem tree…
"Five days, six stalls, one mela," says Hudhud. "Let's discover what makes you shine!"

1.title: Banner Down!

morning.speaker: karim
morning.text: Good morning, everyone! I am Ustad Karim, and this year I am in charge of our Apna Mela.

morning.speaker: karim
morning.text: Our banner is torn and we have six empty stalls. So, {name}, you are now an official Mela Volunteer!

morning.speaker: zain
morning.text: Hey, that means us! I'm Zain. I'll show you around today.

morning.speaker: zain
morning.text: Every stall has a Job Board full of jobs from the mela committee. Pick any three stalls a day and lend a hand!

morning.speaker: zain
morning.text: There are no wrong choices. Just do what sounds good to you.

1.map_tip: Pick any stall. There's no wrong one!

evening.speaker: hudhud
evening.text: Oop-oop! Good evening, {name}. I am Hudhud. I have watched every mela here since before the Ferris wheel first squeaked.

evening.speaker: hudhud
evening.text: Shall I keep a little diary of your week? It is just between us. Two quick questions each night.

1.teaser: Hira has a very long list…

2.title: The Big List

morning.speaker: karim
morning.text: Day two! Hira, our committee head, has something to show you.

morning.speaker: hira
morning.text: Hi {name}, I'm Hira. This is my checklist. It has forty things on it. Forty!

morning.speaker: hira
morning.text: And look at those clouds… Okay. Breathe. We'll take it one stall at a time.

morning.speaker: hira
morning.text: You choose where we go. I'll tick things off!

2.map_tip: Rain or not, the jobs won't wait!

evening.speaker: hudhud
evening.text: The rain never came, and Hira's list is mostly done. Let me open the diary, {name}.

3.title: Stage Fright

morning.speaker: karim
morning.text: The stage frame has arrived! And Bilal will give the opening announcement on Mela Day.

morning.speaker: bilal
morning.text: Hi {name}! I'm Bilal. Who needs a microphone when you have lungs like mine?

morning.speaker: bilal
morning.text: …Okay, maybe I'm a little nervous. Let's keep busy. Busy is good.

3.map_tip: The whole mela needs hands today.

evening.speaker: hudhud
evening.text: Bilal practised his lines on me three times. I gave him a standing ovation. With one foot.

4.title: Picture Perfect

morning.speaker: karim
morning.text: New volunteers have joined us, and Sara is our official mela photographer!

morning.speaker: sara
morning.text: Hey {name}! I'm Sara. Smile! No, a real smile! Perfect.

morning.speaker: sara
morning.text: I'm taking a photo at every stall for the Mela Board. Lead the way!

4.map_tip: Strike a pose at every stall!

evening.speaker: hudhud
evening.text: Tomorrow is the big day, {name}. The whole board is filling up with your photos.

morning.speaker: karim
morning.text: Open the gates! Families are arriving, the Ferris wheel is turning and the chaat smells wonderful.

morning.speaker: karim
morning.text: Today I will walk with you myself, {name}. Three more stalls, and then the closing ceremony!

evening.speaker: hudhud
evening.text: What a day! Before the closing ceremony, one last page of the diary.

zain.karigar: Smell that sawdust! Let's see what needs building.
zain.jugnu: Flasks, a telescope AND a volcano. Science is loud!
zain.rangmahal: So many colours! Careful, the paint is still wet.
zain.madad: This is where lost kids and lost keys end up. Let's see what's needed.
zain.chatkhara: Chaat! Focus, Zain, focus… let's check the Job Board.
zain.hisaab: Tickets, ledgers and a very serious cash box.

hira.karigar: The workshop is on my list three times. Let's see!
hira.jugnu: The science tent! I love how tidy the flasks are.
hira.rangmahal: The art stall looks amazing already. Let's check the board.
hira.madad: The help desk keeps everyone safe. What's on the board?
hira.chatkhara: The chaat stall! Item twenty-two on my list.
hira.hisaab: The ticket office. Let's see what jobs are pinned up.

bilal.jugnu: If the volcano erupts, I'm hiding behind you.
bilal.rangmahal: Do you think they'd paint my face like a tiger?
bilal.madad: The help desk has cold water. Best stall. For now.
bilal.chatkhara: I am only here for the job. Not the chaat. Mostly.
bilal.hisaab: So many tickets. Imagine if they were samosas.

sara.karigar: Great light in the workshop! Let's see the jobs.
sara.jugnu: Click! The telescope looks so cool in photos.
sara.rangmahal: This whole stall is a photo. Let's check the board.
sara.madad: Click! The help desk team is the friendliest.
sara.chatkhara: Steam from the pot makes the best photos!
sara.hisaab: Ticket rolls make a fun picture. What's on the board?

karim.karigar: Ah, the workshop. Every mela stands on good wood.
karim.jugnu: The science tent. Curiosity is the first lamp.
karim.madad: The help desk. A mela is only as good as its welcome.
karim.chatkhara: The chaat corner! Listen to that crowd.
karim.hisaab: The ticket office. Every rupee in its place.

board_prompt: The Job Board has today's jobs. Tap it to start!
all_visits_done: All three stalls done! Off to the evening.

closing.speaker: karim
closing.text: Dear families, students and volunteers… what a mela!

closing.speaker: bilal
closing.text: And the announcer did NOT faint! Thank you, thank you.

closing.speaker: karim
closing.text: Every stall stood strong because each volunteer brought something different.

closing.speaker: karim
closing.text: {name}, Hudhud tells me there is a special page waiting for you. Lights, please!

reveal_intro.speaker: hudhud
reveal_intro.text: All week I wrote down the jobs you chose and the ones you loved.

reveal_intro.speaker: hudhud
reveal_intro.text: Here is what lit you up the most at this mela. Your Mela Code!

ending: Well done, {name}! Thank you for volunteering at Apna Mela.

howto.title: The mela map
howto.text: Each day, choose three different stalls to help at. Any stall, any order. You can visit a stall again on another day.

howto.title: Job Board jobs
howto.text: Tap the Job Board and pick the job you would enjoy most. There are no wrong answers.

howto.title: Loving it?
howto.text: After each job, tap the hearts to show how much you enjoyed it.

howto.title: Twists
howto.text: Little surprises happen at the mela. Choose the answer that sounds most like you.

howto.title: Hudhud's diary
howto.text: Each night Hudhud asks two quick questions. Go with your first honest answer.

howto.title: Mela lights
howto.text: Every answer lights a bulb on the Mela Board. Finish all five days to light all 100!
